description: De-identified offline snapshot derived from the Homework 6 fixed test set.
mapping: Original sample and group identifiers were replaced with sequential case/cluster identifiers; repeat seeds 17 and 43 were mapped to run1/run2.
source_data: Homework 6 data/dataset.json (only used to select original snippets for the blind review packet), results/analysis/candidate_metrics.csv, and successful generation_*.json records.
excluded: No source URLs/titles, glossary, constraints, prompts, request bodies, API endpoint, authorization material, request hashes, response identifiers, timestamps, or model identity fields are included. The original review packet is a separate, small, unlabeled set of source/output examples; the primary agent's subjective Astra judgments are preserved in the separate astra_review.json artifact.
